integrity: Exact polynomial recursion, Bernstein convexity certificate and rational isolating interval are supplied with executable source. Earlier qualitative inequality proofs are acknowledged; no claim of independent review or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The sharp coefficient applies only to four centered unit-variance Gaussian coordinates with a common correlation and fourth powers; no extension to arbitrary covariance matrices, powers, or distributions is claimed. The calculation is a finite exact Wick moment identity plus strict convexity.
title: Sharp quadratic stability for four equicorrelated Gaussian fourth moments
